steps.text: Move with {move}. You always sprint - keep moving to build Flow.
Jump with {jump}, and jump again in the air.
Aim at a blue target and press {cut} to lunge. One clean cut kills.
Red attackers telegraph their swing. Press {parry} the instant it lands.
A parried attacker is staggered - cut it for free.
Sprint to max Flow. When EXECUTE READY shows, your lunge wins trades and is nearly unparryable.
Stay out of their view cones to build Charge. At full Charge you are Shrouded.
Strike a sentry that hasn't seen you - first strikes cut through parries.
Counter-stance with {skill} as a red swing lands - the riposte is automatic.
The Rusher is charging an execute. Parry with {parry} at the last instant - the window is tight.
